# Living build journal — reusable lessons

After every substantial, verified feature, graphics, AI, networking or acceptance milestone, add one short entry. **This is a method/evidence log, not a second roadmap.**

## Template

```markdown
### YYYY-MM-DD — feature/system
**Tested SHA:** commit and CI link (or unverified).
**Change:** gameplay, graphics, source owners and why.
**Tests:** exact commands, pass/fail, unrun full/AI/campaign gates.
**Gameplay / graphics / network / hardware / production:** separate statuses.
**Portable lesson:** what a new game developer should repeat or avoid.
**Missing/next:** concrete visual/feature/device gate.
```

### 2026-11-10 — Figma handoff, scroll-safe menus and responsive Xbox HUD
**Verified game revision:** [`d623d0e`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/d623d0e287aeba6c234094a8167fd202da124bfd) — [GitHub Actions 42909457348](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42909457348) **5/5 quick checks and 1,359/1,359 focused assertions passed**. The final journal-only commit adds no runtime changes.
**Change:** Created an editable 8-screen controller-first [Figma file](https://www.figma.com/design/xCa6EgkpRf0Y1zUxK1yRXD) with 20 colour variables, 12 layout measurements and reusable menu/panel/command components. Added `docs/game-ui-tokens.json`, mapped CSS custom properties to the existing HTML multiplayer room, and updated the Canvas2D shared menu renderer to scroll long lists with persistent gold focus and bounded descriptions. Replaced fixed resource/population/idle/age/clock HUD positions with `hudTopLayout(width)`: one row at 1280/1920 CSS widths and two below 1000; campaign objectives move below the expanded header.
**Verification:** Added screen-width and malformed-state checks, preserved Xbox D-pad selection behaviour, ensured the campaign five-goal preview remains bounded, and included Figma design-contract assertions in the fast hosted selection. A prior failing run exposed brittle absolute-position expectations and a partial Xbox test fixture; corrected those before the green run.
**Acceptance:** UI logic/source + fast software regressions **VERIFIED** at linked SHA. Eight Figma mockups are **design only** and are not a complete shipped UI redesign. No new painted sprites or live deployment, no full standalone/19-campaign regression, no real Chromium layout approval and no physical Xbox Series S picture/FPS acceptance from this batch. Multiplayer remains a preview.
**Portable lesson:** Treat design-system colours/components as a reviewable contract, not an automatic asset export; calculate HUD geometry from the canvas viewport, keep critical clock/resource text visible, use controller fixtures with incomplete game state, avoid tests that freeze a single pixel coordinate, and preserve an inexpensive CI route.
**Next:** Browser screenshots at 720p/1080p plus narrow viewports; verify selected-unit details, command wheels and lower-HUD readability; then continue original Elite sprite production through provenance, source art, animation atlas, offline checks and physical Xbox review.

### 2026-11-10 — Figma-informed command wheels and compact lower HUD
**Tested SHA:** [`82459ef`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/82459efbd3e4c236b7c6112fead3243b5bf48e9d); [GitHub validation run 42911712127](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42911712127) — **5/5 quick gates and 1,363/1,363 focused assertions passed**.
**Change:** `js/ui-commands.js` now presents controller-owned radials as a bounded, scrollable list on narrow viewports (under 720px wide or 500px tall), while desktop retains the wheel. Villager-priority and control-group focus uses slate plus gold outline, not blue-only highlighting. `js/ui.js` docks selected-unit text and a concise controller hint above the four unchanged D-pad shortcuts on narrow screens; the wide Xbox lower HUD remains intact.
**Tests and recovery:** New isolated geometry/focus tests protect command index parity, malformed-menu safety, non-overlapping compact HUD regions and four quick-selection labels. The first runs caught a one-based display assertion and missing token constants in narrowly extracted test fixtures. Repair the harness or preserve local self-contained drawing rules rather than weakening functional assertions.
**Acceptance:** Code and focused software tests **verified** at the linked SHA. Figma artboards remain editable design guides, not finished animations. Browser visual baselines, all standalone regressions, 19 campaigns, Xbox hardware readability/FPS, and deployment freshness **unverified in this change**. No painted asset bytes changed.
**Portable lesson:** Controllers own actions; renderers own fit and focus. Centralize visual tokens, keep wheel item indices untouched during compact fallback, and test screen geometry on realistic 360/480/720/1280 widths. Always use an explicit evidence revision and avoid calling layout unit tests a physical-console signoff.
**Next:** real Chromium 720p, 1080p and small-viewport screenshots, play-scale command readability, wide-HUD overflow checks, and separate painted Elite animation atlas acceptance.
### 2026-11-10 — Chromium screenshots and bounded UI visual acceptance
**Validated revision:** [`b2baa59`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/b2baa59f646ff7a6e1ec20a29faf3d7a652c53ca) — [5/5 quick, 1,367/1,367 focused tests](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42915134961).
**Actual Chromium UI evidence:** [`0520955`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/0520955c3482e7736c5dc23a6dbebdf5597727e4) — [successful four-size browser job](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42914878402), [eight rendered screenshots plus JSON](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42914878402/artifacts/13808338886). The later `b2baa59` changes only a test assertion and leaves these browser-tested runtime files unchanged.
**Work:** Added `tests/browser/hud-layout.mjs` to the existing weekly/manual battlefield browser workflow, plus a 10-minute `[verify-hud-browser]` one-off job in `.github/workflows/game-validation.yml`. It captures actual production Canvas2D `hud()` and `drawRadial()` at 1920×1080, 1280×720, 480×720 and 390×844 (not flattened Figma mockups). It measures real text bounds, asserts that unit hints clear the shortcut dock and panel decoration, verifies selected Market command and minimap/D-pad geometry, traps page exceptions and compares simulation state hashes. The captured canvas uses a deliberately flat background to isolate UI; **terrain/gameplay visuals are not accepted by these screenshots**.
**Findings/repairs:** Real 1280×720 images exposed shortcut/hint overlap; compact views exposed hidden idle-worker count, truncated menu footer, ambiguous selected-position caption and clipped controller hints. Scoped presentation-only fixes eliminated the measured collisions without changing controller command indices, gameplay or save formats. Isolated HUD unit fixtures initially missed layout dependencies and assumed double spaces; repaired them to use real production helpers and compare displayed meaning rather than incidental whitespace.
**Acceptance:** Current UI browser layout **PASSED** at the linked browser SHA; fast software contracts **PASSED** at the linked later test-only SHA. Separate full standalone suite, three seeded AI skirmishes, 19 campaign outcomes, combined game/terrain Chromium scene review and **physical Series S GPU/frame/readability** remain **UNVERIFIED** at this latest revision. Dedicated painted Elite animation sheets remain partial; Production was not deployed.
**Portable lesson:** Pair editable Figma reference artboards with real renderer screenshots and measurable extents; inspect the PNGs because purely geometric tests can miss ornament/text collisions. Keep expensive Chromium opt-in or weekly/manual, store evidence per SHA, and preserve all controller and simulation ownership.
**Next:** Review composited HUD over terrain/fog and long selected-unit text at 720p/1080p on real hardware; continue original four-Elite animation art/provenance, atlas and offline validation.

### 2026-11-10 — Real battlefield/UI composition and two-digit idle-worker acceptance
**Verified runtime SHA:** [`6652ae9`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/6652ae95c1ea527c65b814c64233956c9cb34cda). [Actions 42917969001](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42917969001) **PASSED:** 5/5 quick gates, 1,368/1,368 focused assertions and dedicated Chromium world/UI checks. [Browser artifact](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42917969001/artifacts/13810891141) includes 12 real-world HUD/command screenshots (normal opening and 372-unit/238-building large battle, each at 1280×720, 1920×1080, 390×844), the eight earlier isolated UI images and two machine-readable evidence summaries.
**What happened:** A first composited screenshot unintentionally showed a PAUSED / Controller disconnected overlay: the test restored `mode='pause'` before Playwright captured the world canvas, allowing RAF to replace the intended live match frame. The test now copies the `draw(0)` frame synchronously to a read-only capture canvas, then restores paused state; it checks simulation hashes before/after rendering. The opening match retains genuine unexplored fog; the large-battle scene reveals terrain so the actual painted armies and battlefield can be inspected rather than judging mostly black fog. No simulation ticks are run by the acceptance script.
**Real UI defect found and fixed:** The idle worker chip displayed `Idle …` once there were 10 idle villagers on narrow/720p screens. `js/ui.js` sizes the short caption to the chip and always keeps the actual count, with focused assertions at 390, 1280 and 1920 widths and one real-browser large-army assertion. In the final 1280×720 image, `Idle 10` is fully visible.
**Review limits:** This accepts bounded Chromium screenshots and code/controller integrity only. The browser fixture does **not** measure 30/60 FPS, GPU/CPU frame pacing, controller hardware, long 30Hz simulations, all 19 missions, full standalone tests or production deployment. The live game is not automatically updated. Missing source-grade animated Elite art remains a distinct acceptance gate.
**Portable lesson:** Reuse a representative heavy fixture, synchronize a live-frame capture before leaving play mode, verify actual pixel variation outside HUD panels, inspect PNGs for clipped labels, and protect count-bearing UI from ellipsis. Preserve controller ownership, real game state, and weekly/manual browser cost policy.
**Next:** Series S on-device screenshot/frame pacing in actual skirmishes and large battles, then complete original Elite animation artwork and safe atlas/offline rollout.

### 2026-11-10 — Canonical per-civilization technology tree model
**Verified code revision:** [`4cfce9d`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/4cfce9df22cddf7d04202b9ff66346b7effab331) — [GitHub Actions 42920241225](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42920241225) **PASS: 5/5 quick, 1,373/1,373 focused assertions**. This later journal-only commit does not change the tested runtime.
**What shipped:** `js/kingdom.js` exposes a `technologyTreeModel(team,world)` **read-only, detached-price** snapshot for the existing 26 civilizations. Building troops come from the production/AI/multiplayer `trOf` selector; research comes from the same `rsOf` selector used to authorize actual commands. Expose age gates, prerequisite research, completed/locked/available state, effective research cost and timers; reuse `researchCost` rather than hardcoding the Spanish Blacksmith exception. Fixed the Archery Range Crossbowman replacement branch to use the explicitly supplied `techs` argument rather than stale global `S.tech`. The controller Technology Tree now browses the entire building list with existing D-pad Up/Down, keeps A/B exit semantics, and displays selected building details/costs.
**Regression method:** Test all 26 civilization IDs and Castle unique/Elite research, the Briton Arbalester prerequisite, Spanish Iron Casting's zero-gold price vs another civilization, foreign-world Archer/Crossbowman replacement, no simulation/resource mutation and detached returned price objects. An initial test mistakenly selected Franks for the Arbalester line (which their legitimate restrictions deny); corrected to Britons before the green run. The final test also guards against UI mutation of canonical `U` or `TE` costs.
**Acceptance:** Canonical tech-data presentation and source eligibility **VERIFIED** at above code SHA. Existing 26 civilization rules are still **PARTIAL**, missing base/DLC civilizations and rulesets remain **NOT IMPLEMENTED**, dedicated four Elite art sheets and physical Xbox Series S/menu legibility remain **UNVERIFIED**. No production deployment, new billing, images or sprite manifests.
**Portable lesson:** Avoid secondary technology-rule engines in UI. Derive previews from the same authorized selectors as research/train/AI/network; evaluate against the supplied world rather than mutable global state; expose immutable/detached cost snapshots; test legitimately eligible civilizations and per-team discounts before describing researched tiers as complete.
**Next:** Incorporate shared status/price snapshots into broader civilization/UI/AI availability data, add remaining unique technologies/Elite lines in source-backed batches, then perform actual Xbox technology-tree navigation and readability review.

### 2026-11-11 — Xbox low-zoom terrain memory and Mongol Drill
**Tested SHA:** [`a2d5060`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/a2d506018aa4c9c611085959128f7033c3d337af) — [Actions 42950111633](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42950111633): **5/5 quick, 1,397/1,397 focused assertions passed**; includes new Drill behaviour/save tests.
**Graphics:** The chunk painter now selects a half-resolution **internal** terrain backing when zoom × physical DPR ≤ 0.55, reducing each eligible chunk's pixel storage by 75%. Drawing width/height, crop positions, map layout, original art, unit/building sizes, camera and controller actions are unchanged. Native detail returns at higher pixel density; failed reallocations can continue showing the prior valid chunk. Context recovery also releases old caches.
**Gameplay:** Mongol Imperial Castle research **Drill** (500 wood/450 gold, 60 seconds) gives actual Siege Workshop unit movement +50%, using the single shared movement-speed path. Castle eligibility, AI/host production selectors, technology-tree display and current-build saves use existing canonical systems. Other Mongol bonuses and the broader civilization roster remain partial.
**Acceptance:** Focused software checks **VERIFIED**. The owner's recent Series S photographs show low FPS with four recorded canvas losses, but are from the previously live revision; **no measured device FPS gain, black-screen resolution or production release is claimed**. Full standalone regression, three seeded AI scenarios, 19 campaign simulations and physical Xbox measurements are still separate gates.
**Portable lesson:** Select raster cache resolution by **physical output pixels**, not game-object size; preserve logical coordinates and recover gracefully when a quality upgrade fails. Tie every new faction effect to shared research, simulation, save and restricted-owner validation, and keep inventory counts in fast CI.
**Next:** Run matched 0.8× and 1.0× Series S wide-view FPS/LOSS tests on the next accepted live release, collect normal versus flat-field RAF gaps, and keep completing the existing 26 civilizations without silently redefining original art or shipping unverified optimisations.

### 2026-11-11 — Byzantine Elite Cataphract and Logistica trample
**Tested code SHA:** [`a1c10e4`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/a1c10e4b0a92767dd5110ff1d81732f0e46ab973) — [GitHub Actions 42951639878](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42951639878): **5/5 quick checks, 1,403/1,403 focused tests, zero failures**.
**Gameplay:** Byzantines now have Imperial Castle research for Logistica (800 food, 600 gold, 50 s), plus Elite Cataphract (1,200 food, 800 gold, 50 s). The existing shared research/AI/controller/host eligibility selectors and current-build saves recognize both. Elite research applies +40 current/future Cataphract HP, +3 attack, +5 infantry bonus and +4 resistance against cavalry-counter bonus damage. Logistica adds deterministic five-point armour-ignoring splash to secondary hostile units within a half-tile of a Cataphract melee target. Primary attacks, allies and out-of-range units do not receive unintended splash. The implementation follows the **October 2026 AoE II: DE 185872 Logistica wording**, which removed the legacy extra +6 anti-infantry part; original Crown & Kingdoms Cataphract base statistics remain partially balanced rather than a complete external simulation.
**Tests and correction:** New isolated Castle ownership, timing, resources, Elite health/counter stats, splash, kill accounting, unauthorized civilian/team access and save/load tests. The first run exposed three older damage-module tests and one source-ownership assertion that relied on the original `dmgT(a,t)` interface; `a1c10e4` preserved it with a private, non-serializable Symbol for the armour-piercing secondary hit. The final run is green.
**Acceptance:** Gameplay's focused software contracts **VERIFIED**; current game's Varangian Guard regional unit, remaining Byzantine bonuses, independent Elite sprite animations, full standalone/campaign/seeded-AI suite, Chromium visual review, Xbox physical FPS/controller review, live Vercel deployment and network WAN acceptance remain **PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED**. No `[deploy]` release marker and no paid hosting changes.
**Portable lesson:** For new area-of-effect mechanics, reuse the authoritative damage/death path, keep splash separate from the primary strike so effects never recurse, retain old entrypoint contracts for isolated consumers and make special damage markers impossible to spoof through serialized saves or network unit data.
**Next:** Expand missing Byzantine Varangian and Greek Fire behaviour with original art, then complete more 26-civilization technologies/Elite lines using the same authoritative selectors and test gates.

### 2026-11-11 — Byzantine Greek Fire combat range and Fire Ship rate
**Tested code SHA:** [`9015a28`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/9015a28e97111c123236bf36eb2641a16457a08e) — [GitHub Actions 42952505049](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42952505049): **5/5 quick and 1,409/1,409 focused assertions passed, zero failures**.
**Gameplay:** Corrected Byzantines' Castle Age Greek Fire research to 250 food, 300 gold and 40 seconds. Its Fire Ships now gain +1 range through the shared attackRange used for auto-targeting, player orders, patrol and existing headless/gameplay paths; direct flames are still immediate hits without adding projectile objects. Byzantine Fire Ships also fire 25% faster (`cooldown/1.25`) as a civilization bonus regardless of Greek Fire research. No foreign kingdom inherits either bonus, and normal tower/castle arrows no longer gain the mistaken +4 damage from Greek Fire. Original Fire Ship art, team colours, controller input and ship sizes remain unchanged. Later-age Dromon/Bombard Tower splash effects remain pending their actual unit/building implementations.
**Verification:** New dedicated test covers faction/age/owner Castle restrictions, exact cost/time, research completion, an actual beyond-base-range Fire Ship attack, other-ship exclusion, no projectile creation, unchanged towers and same-build save/load. First CI run passed the new tests but failed one outdated source assertion which required the inaccurate tower bonus; updated that assertion to the true Fire Ship range contract and reran to green.
**Acceptance:** Focused gameplay software **VERIFIED** at above SHA; full standalone regressions, seeded AI, 19 campaigns, Chromium/Xbox visuals, live Vercel and physical Series S performance/black-screen acceptance **NOT VERIFIED** for this revision. The current 26-civilization roster remains partial and Varangian Guards are still missing. No `[deploy]` marker or new paid resources.
**Lesson:** Make research affect the same combat range helper used by authoritative unit orders and AI. Avoid retaining obsolete prototype tech effects simply to satisfy source-pattern assertions; protect the corrected behaviour with a real gameplay test instead. Distinguish the civilization's default attack-rate bonus from its paid, separately gated range technology.
**Next:** Implement Varangian Guard regional Barracks production, gold earned in combat and Logistica interaction for Byzantines/Vikings with original placeholder artwork and Elite tech, without claiming dedicated painted assets until complete; then continue existing faction and DLC gameplay parity.

### 2026-11-11 — Teuton Ironclad through shared combat armour
**Verified code SHA:** [`5864437`](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/commit/58644377bff244812e53a92bb22300e913c562ad); [GitHub validation 42956951072](https://github.com/johnstacey16-ui/crown-and-kingdoms/actions/runs/42956951072) **PASSED 5/5 quick and 1,415/1,415 focused assertions**.
**Gameplay:** Added Teuton Castle Age Ironclad (`ut5p`, 400 wood/350 gold, 60 seconds) to the existing unique-research selector and 26-civilization catalogue. Completed research grants +4 melee armour to Rams, Mangonels, Scorpions, Bombard Cannons and Trebuchets via `combatArmor`, so the live damage resolver and HUD agree. Pierce armour, ships, ordinary soldiers and other civilizations remain unchanged. The central research flow supplies payment, age gates, AI menu eligibility, team state and current-build save/load.
**Verification:** Five new headless cases check technology-tree presentation, Castle research availability/timer/payment, actual incoming attack damage, foreign-team rejection and current-build save restoration. The first CI run passed the new behaviours but exposed two stale source-count expectations; updated professional-readiness (five second unique technologies) and README (262 standalone tests) before the green rerun.
**Acceptance limits:** The existing Teuton Crenellations behaviour is still a prototype, not complete DE parity; the other 26 partial factions and missing DLC remain open. Full standalone regression, three production-AI seeds, 19 scripted campaigns, real Chromium gameplay checks, WAN and physical Xbox Series S frame rate/controls are **UNVERIFIED at this SHA**. No Production deployment or new billing.
**Lesson:** Integrate defensive technologies into the single authoritative armour computation instead of modifying individual spawned units. Test hits, ownership, finished research and saves; treat any changed inventory counts as assertions to reconcile, not as gameplay failures. Follow with verified Imperial Crenellations/remaining Teuton rules in a separate safe slice.
